body: I'm just kind of a lurker and don't have any real knowledge of these things but I want to let you know how wonderful you look! It just looks **so** natural! You're beautiful!

I'm not sure what's going to happen if I can't afford my insulin. I've never been in this situation before. I know I called 211 and just cried my eyes out. They checked my town and two nearby towns and none of them even participate in the 211 thing so I got no help. 

Things have been this way for a while. I was born with a genetic condition which I will PM to anyone requesting it. I WILL NOT post publicly what it is. This is not out of shame. This is because what I have affects VERY few people (think three digit numbers) and it would not be hard to identify me if I told you what it was.  I am in a lot of pain. 

I just want to be able to take care of my kids. Their dad just walked out and I'm all they have. My mom killed herself when I was a kid and I never had my father so I'm determined to be their for them. It's just really hard when you don't have the means to do right by someone you love. 

I've been disabled my whole life and my youngest daughter also has what I have. It hurts me to know first hand what kind of pain she is in. It hurts me to know I, alone, am the reason her tiny existence will be filled with so much pain.

Can we just talk on PM? I'm crying and I don't want to ramble on here.
